name: Service account
short_description: A service account is a shared non-human account used to run automation under one set of credentials; for AI agents it lacks per-agent attribution, ownership, lifecycle and policy enforcement, which is why dedicated agent identities are recommended instead.

evidence.quote: By the end, you'll understand why service accounts are dead.
With traditional service accounts, you create an account, assign permissions, and then manage it for years.
But it's also not a service account.
You glue the flow to a service account, cross your fingers through MFA prompts
as the permissions it's granted. If your flow service account can't read perview's audit log, your agent will
Even if you assign a special service account, someone's going to forget the password expiration
The cracks most often sit in sight over privileged service accounts, tiering violations, unmonitored trusts.
